Its bulk is tied to its source, so gain is about 0.97. Vout is roughly Vgs_n + Vsg_p, about 1.3 V. The budget is 10 + 2 + 14 + 8 uA, about 61 uW."}

```python
PARAMS = {
    "gmid_n": (18.0, 10.0, 24.0),     # inverter NMOS gm/Id
    "gmid_p": (14.0, 8.0, 15.5),      # inverter PMOS gm/Id
    "Lamp":   (0.3, 0.15, 1.0),       # inverter channel length
    "Ia":     (14e-6, 6e-6, 18e-6),   # inverter (tail) current
    "If":     (8e-6, 3e-6, 13e-6),    # follower current
    "Rf":     (320e3, 260e3, 500e3),  # feedback resistor
    "Lf":     (0.3, 0.15, 1.0),       # follower length
    "gmid_f": (14.0, 8.0, 15.5),      # follower gm/Id
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    VDD = 1.8
    kT = 1.380649e-23 * 300.15
    cpd = spec.get("cpd", 5e-13); cl = spec.get("cl", 2e-13)
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    Ip = 2e-6                      # PMOS bias-diode branch current
    Lb, gmb = 1.0, 12.0            # bias devices (mirrors share L and gm/Id)
    Ia, If, Rf = p["Ia"], p["If"], p["Rf"]

    # ---- inverter core (iterate for self-consistent biases) ----
    mn = lut.size("n", p["gmid_n"], p["Lamp"], Ia, vds=0.5)
    vin = mn.vgs
    mn = lut.size("n", p["gmid_n"], p["Lamp"], Ia, vds=vin)
    vin = mn.vgs                                   # DC of input = amp node (no DC in Rf)
    mp = lut.size("p", p["gmid_p"], p["Lamp"], Ia, vds=0.85)
    mp = lut.size("p", p["gmid_p"], p["Lamp"], Ia, vds=mp.vgs)  # vsd = vsg (gate=drain DC)
    vt = vin + mp.vgs
    vds_tail = max(VDD - vt, 0.2)

    # ---- PMOS follower (bulk = own source, no body effect) ----
    mf = lut.size("p", p["gmid_f"], p["Lf"], If, vds=1.3)
    vout = vin + mf.vgs
    mf = lut.size("p", p["gmid_f"], p["Lf"], If, vds=max(vout, 0.3))
    vout = vin + mf.vgs

    # ---- bias network ----
    mb = lut.size("n", 10.0, Lb, iref, vds=0.6)
    mb = lut.size("n", 10.0, Lb, iref, vds=mb.vgs)
    mpd = lut.size("p", gmb, Lb, Ip, vds=0.9)
    mpd = lut.size("p", gmb, Lb, Ip, vds=mpd.vgs)
    vpb = VDD - mpd.vgs
    mn2 = lut.size("n", 10.0, Lb, Ip, vds=max(vpb, 0.2))
    mt = lut.size("p", gmb, Lb, Ia, vds=vds_tail)
    ms = lut.size("p", gmb, Lb, If, vds=max(VDD - vout, 0.15))

    n = Netlist("iin vout vdd vss ibias")
    n.dev("Mb",  "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mb)
    n.dev("Mn2", "pb", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mn2)
    n.dev("Mpd", "pb", "pb", "vdd", "vdd", mpd)
    n.dev("Mt",  "vt", "pb", "vdd", "vdd", mt)
    n.C("Ct", "vt", "vss", 200e-12)               # AC-ground the inverter supply
    n.dev("Mpi", "va", "iin", "vt", "vt", mp)
    n.dev("Mni", "va", "iin", "vss", "vss", mn)
    n.R("Rf", "va", "iin", Rf)
    n.dev("Ms",  "vout", "pb", "vdd", "vdd", ms)
    n.dev("Mf",  "vss", "va", "vout", "vout", mf)

    # ---- small-signal model ----
    gm = mn.gm + mp.gm
    go = mn.gds + mp.gds + mt.gds * 0.0
    Cf = mn.cgd + mp.cgd
    Ci = cpd + (mn.cgg - mn.cgd) + (mp.cgg - mp.cgd)
    gden = mf.gm + mf.gds + ms.gds
    Af0 = mf.gm / gden
    cgs_f = max(mf.cgg - mf.cgd, 0.0)
    Co = max(mn.cdd - mn.cgd, 0) + max(mp.cdd - mp.cgd, 0) + mf.cgd + cgs_f * (1 - Af0)
    Cout = cl + ms.cdd + mf.cdd * 0.5

    def zt(f):
        s = 2j * PI * f
        Yf = 1.0 / Rf + s * Cf
        M = np.array([[s * Ci + Yf, -Yf], [gm - Yf, go + s * Co + Yf]], dtype=complex)
        va = np.linalg.solve(M, np.array([1.0, 0.0], dtype=complex))[1]
        Af = (mf.gm + s * cgs_f) / (gden + s * (Cout + cgs_f))
        return va * Af

    z0 = abs(zt(1e3))
    f3 = 1e10
    for f in np.logspace(4, 10, 1200):
        if abs(zt(f)) < z0 / math.sqrt(2):
            f3 = f
            break

    # input-referred noise at 1 MHz
    w = 2 * PI * 1e6
    en2 = 4 * kT * 1.0 / gm
    in2 = 4 * kT / Rf + en2 * (abs(1.0 / Rf + 1j * w * (Ci + Cf)) ** 2)
    power = VDD * (iref + Ip + Ia + If)

    return n, {
        "zt_dbohm": db(z0),
        "f3db": f3,
        "power": power,
        "vout_dc": vout,
        "in_noise_1m": math.sqrt(in2),
    }
```
